resource: chase search radius around the chaser (Chebyshev)
allocation_impact: Runtime-only: tiles beyond 12 from the chaser are never read; a target with no goal within the radius fails the search and starts the RANGED0-RL-07 wait. Not a route-length cap (AI01-ROUTE-STEPS stays 128).
boundary_tests: max=12: apps/game-server/src/combat/attack/chase.rs a_chase_searches_within_twelve_tiles_and_a_target_beyond_fails_the_search (a goal 12 tiles away is routed)
max+1=13: the same test fails a target whose goal lies 13 tiles away, and a wall spanning the 12-tile radius leaves no route
